title: sida alnifolia var. microphylla
intro: Sida alnifolia var. microphylla, commonly known as Small Mallow, is a plant species in the Malvaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including treating fever, colds, and respiratory issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Small Mallow include soothing coughs, reducing congestion, and calming the digestive system, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Further research is required to confirm the specific health benefits and bioactive constituents of Sida alnifolia var. microphylla, but its traditional uses suggest potential therapeutic applications.
